content:
maria_cs: Heads-up: Polaris preview cohort launches next Tue. Need final confirmed enrollments + 1-line primary use case + one top risk per account by Mon EOD. I'll compile the rollup.

tony_csm: Sending my list now. Quick Q: do we want public-facing trial docs for this cohort or keep it closed? AFAIK several customers asked for SSO + strict data retention.

maria_cs: Keep closed, CS-managed invites only. We'll publish a sanitized FAQ later. Tony, ping me the customers who need SSO.

eli_eng: For SSO we need IdP metadata (entityID, ACS, cert) + whether they require SignedAuthnRequest. Also note: for a couple of accounts we must enable request-level telemetry (token traces) for 24h during the first 48h. That will increase logs.

nora_enable: I'll run a 20-min enablement slot during each kickoff to walk the admin through the provisioning steps. Planning to do template walkthrough + short playbook on common SSO errors. Slot suggestions? Tue/Wed mornings PT.

devops_bob: Heads-up on infra: if we enable debug traces for >24h it's going to bump storage. Recommend we limit to targeted 12-24h windows per account and rotate. We can export traces to the S3 bucket for CS analytics.

maria_cs: Agreed. We'll ask customers to pick a 12h window during their first 48h. Tony, please capture preferred windows in the spreadsheet. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreads/polaris-enroll (do not change header row).

tony_csm: Will do. Also flagging Renewal risk: one pilot account has procurement POs outstanding (expected delay 6-8 weeks). Should we mark as "at-risk" in cohort report?

maria_cs: Yes mark as at-risk. Add a short mitigation plan: 1) schedule exec intro 2) expedite trial success metrics 3) surface ROI in week 2.

eli_eng: For feedback capture, recommend: 1) short weekly survey (3 Qs) 2) one recorded session at week 1 to gather logs + prompts 3) automated evals on our eval harness against their success_metric. We'll need sample prompts from customers by day 3 of cohort.

nora_enable: I'll own the survey template and the recorded session setup. Will put draft into the enablement drive by EOD Fri.

maria_cs: Adding two columns to the sheet: "success_metric" and "risk_summary". Also add "preferred_trace_window" and "SSO_ready". Fill before Mon EOD.

scheduler-bot: Meeting scheduled: Polaris kickoff - Tue 09:00 PT (CS + Eng + Enablement). Invite sent.

maria_cs: Rollout checklist (minimal):
```
- Confirm enroll list (CS)
- Capture 1-line use case + success_metric (CS)
- SSO metadata collected (Customer -> Nora)
- Trace window assigned (Tony -> Devops)
- Enablement session scheduled (Nora)
- Weekly survey enabled (Nora)
- Eval harness ready (Eng)
- Risk flags + mitigation logged (CS)
```

devops_bob: I'll prepare a small script to rotate debug tracing and export to s3://redwood-polaris-traces. Will share the runbook in #eng-infra.

tony_csm: Filling the sheet now. Also adding a "close-loop" column to track when a blocker is resolved.

maria_cs: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers collecting IdP metadata or customers ask for longer trace windows, escalate to me. We want clean logs for the evals but not surprised billing.

eli_eng: One more: please collect 3 canonical prompts per customer so the evals can run. Prefer short + long + edge-case.

nora_enable: Will add that to the enablement checklist.

maria_cs: Thanks all. I'll post the compiled enrollments and the sanitized kickoff notes after the kickoff. If you're owning an action, please update the sheet row as you complete it.

scheduler-bot: Reminder: Polaris kickoff in 24 hours.
